title: PMC-LLaMA: toward building open-source language models for medicine

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《PMC-LLaMA: toward building open-source language models for medicine》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Objective · abstract-1-1】Recently, large language models (LLMs) have showcased remarkable capabilities in natural language understanding. While demonstrating proficiency in everyday conversations and question-answering (QA) situations, these models frequently struggle in domains that require precision, such as medical applications, due to their lack of domain-specific knowledge. In this article, we describe the procedure for building a powerful, open-source language model specifically designed for medicine applications, termed as PMC-LLaMA.

【Materials and methods · abstract-2-1】We adapt a general-purpose LLM toward the medical domain, involving data-centric knowledge injection through the integration of 4.8M biomedical academic papers and 30K medical textbooks, as well as comprehensive domain-specific instruction fine-tuning, encompassing medical QA, rationale for reasoning, and conversational dialogues with 202M tokens.

In this article, we describe the procedure for building a powerful, open-source language model specifically designed for medicine applications, termed as PMC-LLaMA.

We adapt a general-purpose LLM toward the medical domain, involving data-centric knowledge injection through the integration of 4.8M biomedical academic papers and 30K medical textbooks, as well as comprehensive domain-specific instruction fine-tuning, encompassing medical QA, rationale for reasoning, and conversational dialogues with 202M tokens.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《PMC-LLaMA: toward building open-source language models for medicine》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Materials and methods · abstract-2-1】We adapt a general-purpose LLM toward the medical domain, involving data-centric knowledge injection through the integration of 4.8M biomedical academic papers and 30K medical textbooks, as well as comprehensive domain-specific instruction fine-tuning, encompassing medical QA, rationale for reasoning, and conversational dialogues with 202M tokens.

【Discussion · abstract-4-1】Our contributions are 3-fold: (1) we build up an open-source LLM toward the medical domain. We believe the proposed PMC-LLaMA model can promote further development of foundation models in medicine, serving as a medical trainable basic generative language backbone; (2) we conduct thorough ablation studies to demonstrate the effectiveness of each proposed component, demonstrating how different training data and model scales affect medical LLMs; (3) we contribute a large-scale, comprehensive dataset for instruction tuning.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《PMC-LLaMA: toward building open-source language models for medicine》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Results · abstract-3-1】While evaluating various public medical QA benchmarks and manual rating, our lightweight PMC-LLaMA, which consists of only 13B parameters, exhibits superior performance, even surpassing ChatGPT. All models, codes, and datasets for instruction tuning will be released to the research community.

【Conclusion · abstract-5-1】In this article, we systematically investigate the process of building up an open-source medical-specific LLM, PMC-LLaMA.
